product_one_liner.value: Obsidian Security helps enterprise security teams discover and govern third-party SaaS applications and AI agents, enforce least-privilege access, and detect and respond to identity and application threats.

eng_blog.notes: Technical product-development posts cover the impossible-travel model (co-authored by Machine Learning Engineer Marcus McCurdy) and purpose-built OAuth detections (co-authored by Staff Security Researcher Noah Corradin).

public_docs.notes: The documentation endpoint displays “Session Expired” and requires access through the book icon inside a customer Obsidian portal; no publicly readable multi-article documentation portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: AI Security Engineer – Taiwan is listed among current openings; the role develops AI threat models and AI-security product capabilities.

model_provider.notes: No specific model or inference provider used by Obsidian itself was verified after checking public AI product/FAQ material, technical blog material, the Trust Center and DPA/subprocessor disclosures. Supported customer integrations with Claude, ChatGPT and other platforms do not establish Obsidian’s own provider.

compliance_certs.notes: Limited to the five frameworks requested; customer-facing compliance mapping is not treated as Obsidian certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 4, 2026 announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive – San Francisco Bay Area appears on the current job board.

launched_6mo.notes: Announced July 21, 2026: integration with Claude’s Compliance API to continuously monitor configurations and surface risky settings.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No qualifying external C-level/VP join or departure was conclusively dated within November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026. The official go-to-market leadership appointment announcement is dated July 9, 2025, outside the window; a later secondary report conflicts with that date. The current leadership page does not provide start dates sufficient to establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: An archived AI GTM Engineer posting explicitly describes consolidating GTM data across these systems; the posting is closed and is used only as stack evidence, not as an open AI role.
